title: 第15章 炽火神铁第16章 飞仙诀
content_zh:
;;
眼前，红木盒内，一块漆黑的石头静静躺在其中，看上去没有任何的不同。
然而，张邋遢看到这块石头后，神色却少有的起了变化。
“怎么，这块石头有什么不同吗？”
秦婀娜不解地问道，此前，她已看过了这块石头，并没有发现什么特别之处。
“秦婀娜，你虽然修为比我高那么一点，但是，见识这个东西，你就要比我这老头子差上许多了。”
张邋遢恢复心神，看着眼前女子，咧嘴一笑，道，“你知道这是什么吗？”
“不知道。”秦婀娜摇头道。
“这是炽火神铁。”
说话间，张邋遢将一缕真气输入石头中，顿时，整块石头开始发生变化，一丝丝裂痕出现，热浪汹涌。
一旁，秦婀娜见状，神色微凝。
“这神铁可是天下间至阳的神物，据说是天上星辰坠落人间后，在地火中孕育万年形成的宝物，某种程度来说，比你那青霜剑所用的千年寒铁还要珍贵。”张邋遢说道。
“某种程度？”
秦婀娜闻言，眸子微眯，道，“什么意思？”
“就是中看不中用的意思。”
张邋遢皮笑肉不笑地说道，“你是不是想用这神铁给那小子铸一柄属于他自己的剑？我劝你还是别想了，这东西是在地火中孕育而成的，世间恐怕再难有什么火焰能将它熔化，要用它来铸剑，基本不可能，所以，这东西也就是看着珍贵，实际上，啥用没有。”
“一点办法都没有吗？”秦婀娜皱眉道。
“有，但是非常难。”
张邋遢想了想，回答道，“我曾经在一本古籍中看过，孤阴不长，独阳不生，古时大炼器师在炼器时，都会在神料中加入性质相反的东西，既能防止神料过刚易折，又能帮助神料成形。”
“性质相反的东西？”

秦婀娜轻声呢喃了一句，道，“那便需要极阴之物了。”
“不错，不过，要找到和这炽火神铁同等级的极阴之物，可不是一件容易的事情。”张邋遢凝声说道。
“嗯，确实不容易。”
秦婀娜点头，道，“剑痴，你有没有觉得，此事有些不同寻常。”
“什么意思？”张邋遢不解道。
“祁连山内那些不入流的匪寇，怎么会有此神物，然而，这神铁连我都不认识，而那匪寇首领却知道它的珍贵，将它藏得十分严实，是不是太过奇怪了。”秦婀娜说道。
“听你这么一说，的确有些蹊跷。”
张邋遢皱眉道，“若是偶然得到这宝物还能说的过去，但是，一般人就算见到，也只会将它当成一块破石头，不可能认得出来，那匪寇头子能看出这是一件宝物，若非有人指点，不然，唯一的解释，他早就知道这石头是什么东西。”
“匹夫无罪怀璧其罪，若是他人指点，那匪寇首领保不住这神物。”
秦婀娜平静道，“最大的可能，他早就知道这石头的价值，如此说来，这匪寇首领非是一般人。”
张邋遢颔首，道，“没想到这小小的渝州城到处卧虎藏龙，李府就算了，这城外山中的匪寇都不是寻常之辈。”
“或许，要找和炽火神铁属性相反的极阴之物，还要从匪寇首领那里下手。”秦婀娜说道。
“有道理。”
张邋遢点头，笑了笑，道，“怎么，你要亲自出手？”
“以大欺小的事情，我还干不出来，这神铁既然是李子夜取回，那接下来的事情，还是让他自己做好了。”
秦婀娜平静道，“那匪寇首领不算太强的对手，李子夜努努力，还是能够追得上。”
两人说话间，药房，昏迷中的李子夜缓缓睁开了眼睛，刚要挣扎起身，顿时，胸口一股钻心的剧痛传来，疼的身子都开始打颤。

In front of me, inside the mahogany box, a dark stone lay quietly, looking the same.
However, after Zhang Suluo saw this stone, his expression rarely changed.
"What, is there anything different about this stone?"
Qin Weanna asked puzzledly. She had seen this stone before and found nothing special.
"Qin Wanna, although your cultivation level is a little higher than mine, but when you see this thing, you are much worse than an old man like me."
Zhang Sloppy regained his composure, looked at the woman in front of him, grinned, and said, "Do you know what this is?"
"I don't know." Qin Wanna shook her head.
"This is the Blazing Fire Divine Iron."
As he spoke, Zhang Sugao injected a ray of true energy into the stone. Suddenly, the entire stone began to change, with traces of cracks appearing and heat waves surging.
On the side, Qin Grace's expression became slightly condensed when she saw this.
"This sacred iron is the most sacred object in the world. It is said to be a treasure that was nurtured in the earth's fire for thousands of years after the stars in the sky fell to the earth. To a certain extent, it is more precious than the thousand-year cold iron used in your Qingshuang Sword." Zhang Slutty said.
"To some extent?"
When Qin Grace heard this, she narrowed her eyes slightly and said, "What do you mean?"
"It just means it's not useful."
Zhang said with a sloppy smile, "Do you want to use this magical iron to make that kid a sword of his own? I advise you not to think about it. This thing was bred in the earth's fire. I'm afraid there is no flame in the world that can melt it. It is basically impossible to use it to make a sword. Therefore, this thing looks precious, but in fact, it is of no use."
"Is there no way at all?" Qin Wanna frowned.
"Yes, but it's very difficult."
Zhang Sultan thought for a while and replied, "I once read in an ancient book that the yin does not grow and the yang does not grow. In ancient times, when the great weapon refiners were refining weapons, they would add things with opposite properties to the sacred materials. This can not only prevent the sacred materials from being too strong and easy to break, but also help the sacred materials to take shape."
"Something of the opposite nature?"
Qin Grace murmured softly and said, "Then you need something extremely yin."
"Yes, but it is not easy to find an extremely yin object of the same level as this blazing fire god iron." Zhang said in a sloppy voice.
"Well, it's really not easy."
Qin Wegna nodded and said, "Jianchi, do you feel that this matter is a bit unusual?"
"What do you mean?" Zhang Sloppy asked confused.
"How could those unscrupulous bandits in the Qilian Mountains have such a magical object? However, I don't even know this divine iron, but the bandit leader knew how precious it was and hid it very well. Isn't it too strange?" Qin Wanna said.
"Listening to what you said, it's indeed a bit strange."
Zhang Sultan frowned and said, "It would be okay if I got this treasure by chance, but even if most people see it, they will only regard it as a broken stone and cannot recognize it. The bandit leader can see that it is a treasure. If someone hadn't pointed it out, the only explanation is that he already knew what the stone was."
"Every man is innocent of the crime of harboring a jade. If someone else points it out, the bandit leader will not be able to keep this sacred object."
Qin Grace said calmly, "The greatest possibility is that he has known the value of this stone for a long time. In this case, this bandit leader is not an ordinary person."
Zhang nodded sloppily and said, "I didn't expect that there would be crouching tigers and hidden dragons everywhere in this small city of Yuzhou. Let's forget about the Li Mansion. The bandits in the mountains outside the city are not ordinary people."
"Perhaps, if you want to find something extremely yin that has the opposite properties of the blazing fire god iron, you have to start with the bandit leader." Qin Grace said.
"That makes sense."
Zhang Slutty nodded, smiled, and said, "Why, you want to take action personally?"
"I can't do the big thing to bully the small ones. Since it was Li Ziye who retrieved this magical iron, let him do the next thing by himself.alright. "
Qin Grace said calmly, "The bandit leader is not a very strong opponent, but Li Ziye can still catch up with him if he works hard. "
While the two were talking, in the pharmacy, Li Ziye, who was in a coma, slowly opened his eyes. Just as he was about to struggle to get up, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest, and his body began to tremble in pain.
